CREATE TABLE tag ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, created_by_user_id BIGINT, CONSTRAINT uq_tag_name UNIQUE (name), CONSTRAINT fk_tag_created_by_user FOREIGN KEY (created_by_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL );
CREATE INDEX idx_tag_name ON tag (name); CREATE INDEX idx_tag_status ON tag (status);
